newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says 27 die in Kurdish fighting.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says 27 die in Kurdish fighting.

text.p: Twenty-seven people, including four government soldiers, have been killed in clashes between troops and Kurd rebels in southeast Turkey, the security forces said on Saturday.
They said the security forces killed 23 members of the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) in several clashes in the region in the past week.
The four soldiers were killed when their patrol car hit a landmine in Sirnak province on Friday.
More than 26,000 people have been killed in the PKK's war for independence or autonomy launched in southeast Turkey in 1984.
